title: OtakuStream Goes Live!
description: OtakuStream officially goes live! Welcome to a new destination for anime, movies, and TV shows.

title: Polished Version of OtakuStream Becomes Active
description: A more polished version of OtakuStream becomes active, bringing an improved overall experience.

title: Server Fixes, Stats & Refined Personalization
description: Fixed server-related issues, introduced the stats feature, and refined the history and watchlist enrichment logic.

title: Announcements Feature Added
description: Introduced the Announcements feature to OtakuStream, making it easier to keep users informed about site updates and important news.

title: Performance, Image Loading & HeroBanner Improvements
description: Improved overall performance by reducing unnecessary TMDB detail requests, refining HeroBanner content selection, and optimizing image loading priorities. Updated the Home HeroBanner to prioritize movies and TV shows while placing anime entries last, with a maximum of 12 slides. Refined backdrop and logo preloading, reduced unnecessary image processing, and updated image quality configuration for more efficient image delivery.

title: Password Recovery & Account Security Improvements
description: Introduced an email-based password recovery system using six-digit temporary recovery codes delivered through Gmail SMTP. Added IP-based rate limiting with a five-minute cooldown to reduce repeated recovery requests. Updated the account recovery page with an option to request a new temporary code, clearer recovery instructions, and improved error handling for rate-limited requests. Added reminders encouraging users to save their permanent recovery codes after regaining account access, along with a friendly reminder to use email requests responsibly.

title: TV Seasons Type Safety & TMDB Compatibility Fix
description: Fixed a TypeScript compatibility issue between TMDB season summaries and the TVSeasons component. Introduced a dedicated TmdbSeasonInput structural type in TVSeasons.logic.ts, allowing TMDB season data to be accepted without requiring an incompatible string index signature. Preserved compatibility with existing MediaRecord data and retained the existing season and episode handling logic.

title: Episode & Season Watch Tracking Improvements
description: Added the ability to mark individual episodes as watched and mark an entire season as watched. Introduced new API routes to support watch-status updates and refined the database handling logic to efficiently process large entries, improving reliability and performance when working with extensive watch-history data.

title: Watchlist & Continue Watching Metadata Cache Improvements
description: Refined the metadata enrichment and caching logic for Continue Watching and Watchlist entries. Improved cache handling to prioritize items displayed in the UI, ensuring visible entries receive metadata enrichment and are stored for faster subsequent loading. Optimized cache management to improve consistency and reduce unnecessary metadata requests.

title: Removed Personalized Feed and Optimized the site
description: The feature of Personalized Feed is removed. Few redundant variables too were removed from the site and logic was fine tuned to improve performance and stability.
